body.condition: The fixed benchmark assigns inferior treatment with population mass at least \(b_0\): \(\mathbb E_{P_X}[(1-\pi_0(X))\mathbf 1\{\tau_P(X)>0\}+\pi_0(X)\mathbf 1\{\tau_P(X)<0\}]\ge b_0\).

novel.justification: The condition isolates benchmarks whose gain genuinely depends on the inferior-arm regression. It holds with \(b_0=1/2\) for balanced randomization and with a positive constant for any pre-specified policy bounded away from zero and one.
